summary: Research of w129 done; notes at .shop/scratch/1-research/notes.md. Requests r13 and r14 have no step definitions and no code (both scenarios StepDefinitionNotFound). work show prints work-items only; work status with no initiative prints initiative blocks only. Conflict: requests r14 vs work-queue r17 on work status output (additive vs replacing); the SessionStart hook (migrate_session.py) uses the same output. Model check reports file problem on a .shop/work/requests dir (exit 1) and ignores request sources in w_uncited_obs. Defect: work show exits 1 on a non-UTF-8 request file. Existing status/show/hook tests pass today (run, --whole-suite needed because the environment's --work-item w129 filter raises when none of its scenarios are collected). No test map exists; counts are by search.
questions: Requests r14 and work-queue r17 both govern work status with no initiative: does r14 add observations to the output (additive) or replace the initiative blocks? The SessionStart hook uses the same output.
Should work show refuse (exit 1) when a request file under .shop/work/requests is not UTF-8, as it does for work-items today?
